$comment: HardBuild config. Copy to your project root as .hardbuild.json. Every key is optional; these are the defaults. Gates run from the Stop hook; audit.* feeds /hardbuild:audit.

commands.$comment: Leave empty to auto-detect from package.json scripts (typecheck|type-check|tsc, lint, test:unit|test, build).

$keys.gatedFeatures: feature names that require a paid plan — Billing audit checks server-side entitlement for each
$keys.producerLicenses: state codes where insurance producer/agency license disclosures apply
$keys.allowTestSubmissions: true lets the Landing Page audit submit a clearly marked test lead to prove the CTA path end-to-end
